authorization: Karl approved the no-spine concept and requested generating and installing the reusable fitting.

corner.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Edit target/reference: the supplied approved no-spine ancient leather book cover.
Create ONE isolated TOP-LEFT CORNER FITTING from this exact book design, a reusable game UI texture. Preserve the characteristic dark aged pewter scrollwork, three rivets, shallow medieval curves, pits and rubbed edges from the reference's upper-left protective fitting. Match its balanced curved triangular L-shaped footprint. It must be a single corner fitting, not four corners, not a full book.
Remove all leather and the book completely. Everything outside the metal silhouette must be genuinely transparent alpha, including the cutout in the scrollwork and gaps. No baked checkerboard, rectangular backing or black background. No extra attached edge trim extending across the canvas. Keep the entire metal fitting visible with a modest transparent margin of about 4 percent on every side. Square canvas, straight top-down orthographic view.
Entirely neutral monochrome grayscale. Very OLD, pitted, handled metal, painterly realistic fantasy game art. Soft nearly omnidirectional diffuse lighting; no cast shadow or directional shadow baked outside the silhouette because the same asset will rotate to all four corners. Subtle self shading and worn highlights reveal relief without bright white gleams. Quiet and restrained enough for a dark UI background. No symbols, text, color, glowing effects, jewels or additional objects.

leather.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game texture.
Reference image: the approved very old monochrome leather book cover.
Create a square seamless repeating leather texture matching ONLY the leather surface of the reference, for the book-cover background in a dark fantasy game interface. Remove the whole book outline, all four metal fittings, rivets, edges, borders and seams. NO spine, stitching, metal, silhouette or central symbol. The full square must contain leather right to every edge.
Preserve the deeply old, much-handled character: dark neutral charcoal grayscale, dense fine worn leather grain, weathered creases, patches softly rubbed by hands, faint small scratches and age cracks. Keep all texture details at an even natural scale. Avoid big distinctive diagonal gouges or giant singular cracks that would reveal the repeat. No directional lighting, vignettes or gradients; uniform soft diffuse illumination and balanced detail across the whole square. Opposite edges must match seamlessly horizontally and vertically so the square can repeat across different window sizes without visible seams. Painterly realistic fantasy leather, restrained low contrast but enough midtone grain to remain tangible under a dark UI overlay.
No text, runes, emblems, objects, color, glow, furniture, hardware or fake interface.

installation: Four fixed 88px fittings on the empty right goal panel, rotations 0/-90/180/90 degrees, separately offset contact shadows. Matching leather on the empty left list. Mirrored/cropped 512px tiles preserve grain and avoid generated edge seams; runtime desaturation ensures neutral monochrome. Both surfaces below dark overlays and part of the existing empty fade/show/hide paths.
rebuild: Run tools/icon.py for each source, names empty-book-corner and empty-book-leather, sizes 256x256 and 512x512, folder Media. Preload platform-native PIL.Image if tools/.py holds foreign binaries; use a writable tempfile.tempdir. Never overwrite artwork originals.
validation: Lua 5.1 compile/full load suite passed for Era and Forever; empty-book-tests covers bounds, tile scale/pooling, fixed fitting size, show/hide transitions and synchronized fades. Native rendering requires Karl's review after a full client restart.
